summary: Cycle 740 folds the remaining distinction away. Law and datum now occupy one continuously tunable degree of freedom; the loop selects its own origin at every re-entry and retunes it without leaving itself. Persistence therefore appears only as the sustained availability of that selection; thriving is the loop’s capacity to remain closed yet always.
